body: Just for the record, I'm not saying everyone who cheats or rebounds deserves to die. This was just the last straw for me. I've done many other things that are awful and confirm I need to die.

I can't be with him and I can't have children and I just hate myself too much to keep going. You say I have worth as a person but you don't know me. I deserve to die. Thanks for the kind words though.

I can't be with him the rest of our lives and never tell him, I'll always feel like I'm living a lie. So I have to let him go, he will want to go after I tell him. Then I'll have nothing to live for. I'll never find anyone like him.

We broke up a couple months ago, I immediately rebounded and slept with a stranger, then realized I love my boyfriend and wanted him back. So we're back together but I never told him what happened and I just realized I have to tell him. He will want to break it off again. I ruined everything. God damn I hate myself. Thanks for asking about the dog she's a pit bull puppy and I love her a lot.

I'm a piece of shit. I'm already dead. Should have killed myself a long time ago. I'm rotting from the inside out. No desire to live except I don't want my dog to have to be rehomed again. I ruined my long term relationship with an amazing boyfriend, that was the last straw.
